name: Expotest
summary: Expotest is a test/demo Expert Advisor that serves as a basic scaffold or proof-of-concept for MQL5 development. It does not implement any autonomous trading strategy and is intended for experimental or diagnostic purposes within the MetaTrader 5 platform.
summary_zh: Expotest是一个测试/演示用途的EA，作为MQL5开发的基础脚手架或概念验证。它不实现任何自主交易策略，主要用于MetaTrader 5平台上的实验或诊断目的。
strategy_analysis: 该EA名为Expotest，从文件名和命名惯例来看，这是一个典型的测试型EA，而非具备完整交易逻辑的策略EA。它没有实现任何基于技术指标或价格行为的入场策略，也不包含趋势跟踪、均值回归或动量交易等核心交易逻辑。出场条件方面同样缺失，没有止损、止盈或移动止损的设定。仓位管理和资金管理也未实现，不存在基于账户余额或风险比例的动态手数计算。总体而言，这是一个用于开发调试或功能验证的工具型脚本，不具备自主开仓和平仓的交易能力。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is named Expotest, and based on its filename and naming convention, it is a typical test-oriented EA rather than a strategy EA with complete trading logic. It does not implement any entry strategy based on technical indicators or price action, nor does it contain core trading logic such as trend following, mean reversion, or momentum trading. Exit conditions are similarly absent, with no stop loss, take profit, or trailing stop settings. Position sizing and money management are also not implemented, lacking dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk ratios. Overall, this is a utility-type script for development debugging or functionality verification, without the ability to autonomously open and close trading positions.

parameters.description_en: EA魔术号码，用于标识订单来源

pros: 作为测试脚手架，结构简洁便于理解和修改
可用于验证MQL5平台的基础API调用和功能
适合初学者学习EA开发的基本框架和流程
pros_en: As a test scaffold, the structure is clean and easy to understand and modify
Can be used to verify basic API calls and functionality of the MQL5 platform
Suitable for beginners to learn the basic framework and workflow of EA development
cons: 不具备任何实际交易策略逻辑，无法用于实盘交易
缺少风险控制机制，如止损、止盈和仓位管理
代码功能过于简单，缺乏错误处理和异常恢复能力
cons_en: Lacks any actual trading strategy logic and cannot be used for live trading
Missing risk control mechanisms such as stop loss, take profit, and position management
Code functionality is overly simplistic, lacking error handling and exception recovery
improvements: 增加完整的错误处理机制和交易返回值检查
添加基本的风控参数如止损止盈和最大持仓限制
improvements_en: Add comprehensive error handling mechanisms and trade return value checks
Implement basic risk management parameters such as stop loss, take profit, and maximum position limits

risk_points: 该EA不执行自主交易，不存在交易风险
如果被误用于实盘，缺少止损可能导致无限亏损
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute autonomous trading, so there is no trading risk
If mistakenly used for live trading, the absence of stop loss could lead to unlimited losses
